manifestContract.rule: Only entries under sources are canonical. plannedSources never become authoritative until promoted by a later task and validated.

systemModel.axisPolicy: Platform context axes are orthogonal. Platform identifies the execution family only and must not imply viewport, input modality, motion, color scheme, or content scale.

platformStatus.note: V2 targets and current adapter maturity are intentionally separate. T002 establishes the four-platform context model; adapter maturity remains downstream work.

ios.basis: Shared React Native token output and iOS touch-target mapping exist; native platform/component contract remains V2 work.

android.basis: Shared React Native/NativeWind outputs and Android touch-target mapping exist; native platform/component contract remains V2 work.

web.basis: Tailwind adapter output exists; V2 responsive/input/platform contract remains pending.

wechat-mini-program.basis: No Mini Program adapter exists on dev; T009 owns the minimum viable adapter.

legacyTokenJsonBundle.reason: These paths were declared by the old manifest but do not exist on dev. colors_and_type.css is the current build truth.

legacySplitComponentSpecs.reason: These files do not exist on dev. components/index.json is the current component catalog entrypoint.

compositePolicy.promotionRule: Promote a recurring assembly to a Core Composite Component only when it has stable anatomy, interaction and consumption identity across products without product-domain names, routes or state enums.

patternPolicy.promotionRule: Promote a recurring multi-component UX solution only when its intent and behavior remain reusable without product-domain names or state enums.

themeResolution.sharedNamespacePolicy: theme-independent shared semantics such as icon and loading-indicator visual sizes resolve before the active theme and are not patched by theme overrides
themeResolution.dark: re-resolve aliases against the .dark override table parsed from colors_and_type.css before component tokenRef resolution
themeResolution.contractShortRefs: resolve after active theme values; absolute semantic.shared.* refs bypass theme patching by design

modeResolution.density: resolve density variables from the normalized model built from colors_and_type.css
modeResolution.platform: read the V2 platform family from sources.platformModel; platform name does not imply input, viewport, motion, color scheme, or content scale
modeResolution.viewport: T002 defines the context axis; T012 owns responsive behavior and layout rules
modeResolution.input: T002 defines the explicit modality axis; T012 owns interaction-state and responsive input behavior
modeResolution.motion: T002 defines standard/reduced context selection; current consumer values still resolve from colors_and_type.css until T011 introduces the platform-neutral motion contract
modeResolution.colorScheme: light/dark context selects the existing themeResolution path
modeResolution.contentScale: T002 defines standard/enlarged/platform-driven context selection; downstream environment/layout contracts own platform hooks and reflow behavior

governance.literalGeometryPolicy: retain literals only when no stable cross-component semantic role has emerged

releaseGates.policy: This manifest declares requirements, not pass results. A gate is green only when deterministic validation or review evidence says so.
